Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Remix.name: Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Remix
Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Remix.summary:
Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Remix is a table game developed and published by Jaleco for the Sega Saturn. It is part of Jaleco's Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai series.

Saturn "Remix" version removes some censorship and changes some music compared to the first Saturn release. Game content is not changed from Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Special, only part of the naked graphics and BGM has been changed.
